gloss: to protrude; to stand out; to excel

definitions.gloss: to protrude; to jut out; to stick out
definitions.explanation: For something to extend outward or project beyond a surface or boundary. A physical protrusion.

definitions.gloss: to stand out; to excel; to be outstanding
definitions.explanation: To be notably superior or prominent compared to others. Used to describe exceptional performance, talent, or characteristics.

examples.japanese: {岩|いわ}が{突出|とっしゅつ}している。
{建物|たてもの}の{一部|いちぶ}が{道路|どうろ}に{突出|とっしゅつ}している。
examples.english: Part of the building is protruding into the road.

examples.japanese: あの{地域|ちいき}は{地震|じしん}の{発生|はっせい}{率|りつ}が{突出|とっしゅつ}して{高|たか}い。
examples.english: That region has an outstandingly high earthquake occurrence rate.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{成績|せいせき}は{突出|とっしゅつ}している。
この{選手|せんしゅ}は{突出|とっしゅつ}した{才能|さいのう}を{持|も}っている。
{日本|にほん}は{世界|せかい}の{中|なか}で{高齢|こうれい}{化|か}{率|りつ}が{突出|とっしゅつ}している{国|くに}だ。
examples.english: Japan is a country with an outstandingly high aging rate in the world.

notes:
The figurative sense (standing out, excelling) is more common in everyday usage than the literal physical sense. Often used with して as an adverb: {突出|とっしゅつ}して{高|たか}い (outstandingly high).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {突出|とっしゅつ}した{才能|さいのう} — outstanding talent
- {突出|とっしゅつ}して{高|たか}い — outstandingly high
- {突出|とっしゅつ}した{成果|せいか} — outstanding results
- {突出|とっしゅつ}した{存在|そんざい} — an outstanding presence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {目立|めだ}つ — to stand out, be conspicuous; more casual and neutral
- {優|すぐ}れる — to excel, be superior; focuses on quality
- {飛|と}び{抜|ぬ}ける — to be far ahead of others; more colloquial
